defaults.composition: One clear anchor in the middle ground, such as a single tree, a mossy log, a fern bank or a short bend of path, with soft leaves or grass along the bottom edge and blurred woodland behind; the view looks across the anchor from the side.

shots.subject: A single old beech tree with a mossy base on a gentle woodland slope, its low branches in translucent new leaves and thin mist among the trees behind.
shots.motion_elements: the new beech leaves and the thin mist

shots.subject: A fallen mossy oak log lying across the frame on a woodland floor, young ferns growing along its length and sunlit birch trunks behind.
shots.motion_elements: the young ferns

shots.subject: A bank of unfurling bracken fronds catching low warm light at the edge of a wood, a few birch trunks behind and soft green woodland beyond.
shots.motion_elements: the bracken fronds

shots.subject: A cluster of three slender birches with pale green catkins, white wood anemones spread loosely at their feet and a soft grey-green wood behind.
shots.motion_elements: the catkins and the anemones

shots.subject: A mossy boulder beside a small woodland rivulet after rain, wet hart's-tongue ferns around it and droplets on the young leaves above.
shots.motion_elements: the rivulet and the fern fronds

shots.subject: A short path edged with moss and wood sorrel bending sideways around a large oak trunk, with soft mist hazing the trees behind.
shots.motion_elements: the soft mist and the wood sorrel leaves

shots.subject: A hazel coppice stool with many slender stems and fresh round leaves, a patch of yellow celandines at its foot and a sunny woodland behind.
shots.motion_elements: the hazel leaves

shots.subject: A hawthorn bush in white blossom at a woodland edge, low sun behind it rimming the flowers in warm light and tall grass in front.
shots.motion_elements: the blossom sprays and the grass

shots.subject: A mossy stone outcrop on the forest floor wrapped in ivy and ferns, a clump of wild garlic beside it and smooth beech trunks behind.
shots.motion_elements: the ferns and the wild garlic leaves

shots.subject: A rain-dark beech trunk with smooth bark and a ring of fresh moss at its foot, a puddle beside it reflecting new leaves and a wet canopy above.
shots.motion_elements: the puddle reflection and the canopy leaves

shots.subject: A young rowan tree with fresh feathery leaves standing in a small woodland clearing, dewy grass around it and pale light behind the trunks.
shots.motion_elements: the rowan leaves and the dewy grass

shots.subject: A fern-covered bank sloping across the frame, lady ferns and male ferns in bright new green, a moss-covered root crossing it and sunny trees behind.
shots.motion_elements: the fern fronds

shots.subject: A small wild cherry tree in white blossom in a woodland clearing, its crown spread across the middle of the frame, warm low light and soft green trees behind.
shots.motion_elements: the blossom branches

shots.subject: A gnarled old oak root plate covered in moss, scattered bluebells between the roots and fresh green leaves on the low branches overhead.
shots.motion_elements: the bluebells and the low leaves

shots.subject: A short section of wet woodland path with a shallow puddle and bright moss edges, curving away sideways between young hornbeams dripping from the rain.
shots.motion_elements: the puddle surface and the dripping hornbeam leaves

shots.subject: A sloping bank of bilberry and young birch saplings under spaced pines, with pale lit morning mist hanging behind them.
shots.motion_elements: the birch saplings and the morning mist

shots.subject: A clump of Queen Anne's lace and tall grass at the edge of a woodland glade, an old oak in new leaf behind and sunlight dappling the plants.
shots.motion_elements: the Queen Anne's lace and the tall grass

shots.subject: A curved hazel branch with dangling yellow catkins reaching across a woodland glade, warm evening light behind and mossy ground below.
shots.motion_elements: the yellow catkins

shots.subject: A moss-covered tree stump with young ferns and wood sorrel growing from it, a carpet of bluebell leaves around it and soft light through the beech canopy.
shots.motion_elements: the young ferns

shots.subject: A clump of royal ferns and marsh marigolds in a wet woodland hollow after rain, glossy leaves in front and soft mist among the alders behind.
shots.motion_elements: the fern fronds and the mist

shots.subject: A birch trunk leaning across the frame over a mossy bank, fresh small leaves along its branches and a soft hazy glow in the woodland behind.
shots.motion_elements: the small birch leaves

shots.subject: A loose patch of wood anemones and wood sorrel among moss around a rotting log, with sunlit young beeches standing behind.
shots.motion_elements: the anemone flowers and the sorrel leaves

shots.subject: A single young oak in pale gold-green leaf standing in tall grass at the edge of the wood, softly backlit, with darker woodland behind.
shots.motion_elements: the oak leaves and the tall grass

shots.subject: A low dry-stone wall covered in moss and small ferns running diagonally across the frame, hazel shrubs in fresh leaf growing behind it.
shots.motion_elements: the small ferns and the hazel leaves

shots.subject: A cluster of mossy boulders in a beech wood after rain, a beech sapling with wet young leaves in front and soft mist in the background.
shots.motion_elements: the beech sapling leaves and the mist

shots.subject: A soft mossy hummock with a cluster of pale primroses, a fallen branch beside it and a pale morning wood behind in thin mist.
shots.motion_elements: the primroses and the thin mist

shots.subject: The low branches of a lime tree in fresh heart-shaped leaves hanging across the upper frame, over a grassy woodland floor with sunlit trunks behind.
shots.motion_elements: the heart-shaped lime leaves

shots.subject: A small sunlit gap in the wood with tall grass and bracken shoots, a moss-covered stump at its center and warm light on the leaves around it.
shots.motion_elements: the tall grass and the bracken shoots

shots.subject: A thicket of young beech saplings with pleated new leaves, a mossy floor beneath and the grey trunks of older trees behind.
shots.motion_elements: the pleated new leaves

shots.subject: A shallow woodland brook bending around mossy stones after rain, wet ferns overhanging the clear water and a green woodland of young beech and ash behind.
shots.motion_elements: the flowing brook and the ferns

shots.subject: A small woodland clearing with a single blackthorn bush in white blossom, dew on the grass around it and mist among the trunks beyond.
shots.motion_elements: the dewy grass and the mist

shots.subject: A pair of tall beech trunks with a wide mossy root plate between them, fresh green leaves fluttering in the canopy above and a sunny glade behind.
shots.motion_elements: the canopy leaves
